title: Component Usage
description: How to use a component: when to use it, what not to use it for, its named patterns, when to use each variant option, and how it composes (ADR-001 amendment 2026-11-10). The builder sections live in <Name>.spec.json (ADR-027).

description.description: Opens on one category noun ("A <noun> that …"). No counts, ADR references or accessibility claims.

figmaNodeId.description: The Figma component set node id, or "none" when the component has no set (layout, text styles, single components).

useWhen.description: Situations where this component is the right choice at all. Which variant option to use goes in variants.<axis>.useWhen.

notFor.description: Wrong picks: situations that look like this component but need another one.

instead.description: The fixed-set component to use instead, or null when the alternative is outside the library (say what in note).

patterns.description: Named, proven compositions using this component. Prefer a named pattern over ad-hoc composition when one fits.

tree.description: Component tree as a readable expression, e.g. 'Card > Stack > [Heading, Text, Button(primary)]'

variants.description: Named variant axes. Each key is an independent axis (e.g. variant, size, shape). A single-axis component declares one axis named `variant`; a component with no visual variation declares `variant` with a single `default` option.

default.description: Default option for this axis, or null when the axis is off by default (e.g. an icon-only shape applied only when set).

useWhen.description: Per option: the situation first, then at most one clause on how it looks. Sizes in px and required props belong in the spec.

composition.description: How this component composes: what it accepts, where it belongs, its parts, how it sizes, and the rules and counts for combining it.

accepts.description: Component names valid as direct children in this component's content slot. Empty array means leaf node. ["*"] means any library component is valid.

containedBy.description: Component names that are valid direct parents of this component.

parts.description: Subcomponents reachable as <Name>.<Part> (ADR-023). Parts are not components: they have no folder and are declared only here. Cross-references (accepts/containedBy/builtOn) are checked by scripts/validate-usage.js.

name.description: PascalCase part name; also the Figma layer name (naming contract, ADR-023).

kind.description: fixed = content/state props only, layout owned by the parent's CSS Module; slot = exactly one child from accepts; open = any children from accepts, laid out by a primitive with fixed props.

builtOn.description: Library component this part renders (e.g. Stack for an open part), or null when it renders plain elements.

required.description: Whether every instance of each containedBy part must include this part as a direct child.

accepts.description: Component or sibling-part names valid as direct children. slot and open parts only.

containedBy.description: Sibling-part names valid as this part's direct parent. Omit when the part may appear anywhere (e.g. Root).

width.description: fill = stretches to parent width; hug = sizes to content; fixed = component sets its own width.

nests.description: Whether an instance can sit inside another instance of the same component. Checked by validate-layout.

limits.description: Counts as data, checked by validate-layout. per: region = the nearest <section>; repeated = inside a repeated item (CardVertical, CardHorizontal or a .map()); parent = the direct parent.

if.description: Variant axis → option the limit applies to.

rules.description: Composition rules that can't be stated as data: placement, grouping, weight in context. Each says what to do instead.
